content:
anya: FYI a partner surfaced PII showing up in our debug dump. root cause looks like route header being added by the old proxy after redaction, so route-based redaction didn't run. we should decide short+mid term fixes.

samir: ouch. is this only for legacy-proxy paths?

anya: yes, legacy-proxy injects `X-Route` post-logger. our scrub step currently consults route rules.

taylor: quick mitigation: perform a small, cheap pass that strips obvious PII (emails, api keys, cc) before we consult headers. call it "preflight-scrub". then do full, route-aware scrub.

lina: preflight-scrub needs a tiny ruleset (regex/email/token) to avoid NLP heuristics. avoid over-redaction.

marta: perf question: two scrubs doubles CPU. on heavy tenants that trips autoscaling and quota alarms. can we offload preflight to edge (CloudFront/Lambda@Edge) for public traffic? cheaper than doubling core.

samir: offload is promising but edge introduces ops surface. also not all customers go through our CDN. for internal plan: feature-flag preflight by tenant tag and default-on for `ingress_untrusted` routes.

ops-bot: note: enabling preflight for a tenant will increase per-token CPU by ~10-18% (empirical). alerts may fire if tenants are near committed capacity.

anya: alternative medium-term: keep single scrub but move route-attestation earlier. require proxies to send `X-Route-Signature` (HMAC over path+route) and validate before scrub. if signature verifies, we can trust route-aware scrub.

lina: HMAC validation avoids double work but needs rollout plan + key rotation + proxy changes. timeline: ~3-4 weeks for infra + backward-compatibility mode.

devex: Console implications: users will notice fewer fields in quick inspector if preflight runs. we should add an indicator: badge "preflight-redacted" and a tooltip explaining why. also add a "routed view" toggle to switch between preflight vs post-route rendering (with clear audit trail).

marta: breakglass: ops asked previously for ability to temporarily unmask a tenant to debug. that's super risky. propose: allow breakglass only with SRE+Legal approval, one-time token, TTL 5m, audit log and customer notification. UI must surface justification.

samir: +1. also track `breakglass_attempts` metric and alert if >2 in 24h.

anya: telemetry: create metrics: `preflight_applied`, `preflight_false_positive_rate` (sampled), `post_scrub_leak_detects` (alerts on any leak after scrub), and `route_signature_failures`. dashboards should have per-tenant filters.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-PRIV-122 to add `preflight_applied` and `post_scrub_leak_detects` to the privacy dashboard.

taylor: config sketch I had in mind:
```yaml
pipeline:
  - preflight_scrub:
      ruleset: preflight_minimal
      enabled: conditional
  - route_assign
  - route_scrub:
      ruleset: tenant_profile
routing:
  accept_signed_routes: true
  signature_header: X-Route-Signature
  signature_algo: hmac-sha256
```

lina: I'll draft a concise RFC for `preflight_minimal` listing exact regexes and excluded fields. scope = email, credit-card formats, API keys (common prefixes), SSN-ish digits. avoid removing short strings or legit tokens.

marta: ops tasks: map tenants close to capacity and propose tagging candidates for offload to Dedicated or enable edge-scrub. I'll add a script to compute impact.

samir: I'll benchmark double-scrub vs HMAC-validate-and-single-scrub on representative models (gpt-ish 16k). want numbers by EOD Mon.

devex: docs: update SDK and Console docs to explain the new `ingress_untrusted` flag, `accept_signed_routes` behavior, and breakglass process + audit. include examples of how Console "routed view" differs from the preflight view.

anya: decisions for this thread: short-term = deploy preflight_minimal behind tenant-flag for ingress_untrusted routes. medium-term = implement route attestation (HMAC) and revert to single-pass scrub for signed routes. breakglass allowed with SRE+Legal + TTL + audit.

lina: sounds good. I'll open the RFC and small ruleset PR.

marta: I'll also draft the runbook for breakglass and the ops script for tenant-impact mapping.

samir: will run perf tests and share numbers.

devex: will prep console copy and tooltip strings.

anya: action list recap:
- lina: RFC + preflight ruleset PR (due Wed)
- samir: perf benchmarks double-scrub vs signed-route flow (due Mon)
- marta: tenant capacity mapping + breakglass runbook stub (due Thu)
- devex: Console flag UI copy + docs updates (due Thu)
- ops-bot: track INF-PRIV-122 and publish dashboard tiles (preflight_applied, post_scrub_leak_detects, breakglass_attempts) (due Mon)

anya: ping me if you spot other proxies adding headers post-logger. I'll collate examples. thanks all. :thumbsup:
